links.comparator_used: No uncalibrated-model arm reported; the calibrated framework was compared with QDiabetes-2018 run on the same synthetic cohort
links.outcome: Calibration (ECE and calibration-in-the-large O:E ratio) after isotonic recalibration on a held-out calibration set
links.effect: ECE = 0.006, but mean predicted risk was 8.4% vs observed 5.6% (O:E = 0.66, 95% CI 0.65-0.67), with overprediction in 9 of 10 risk deciles; QDiabetes-2018 had O:E = 0.89 and AUC 0.831 vs the framework's 0.844
links.tradeoff: Low bin-level ECE masked systematic 50% overprediction; recalibration on the deployment population is still likely to be needed.
links.quote: This miscalibration occurred despite isotonic regression on a held-out calibration set.

design_hint: post-hoc isotonic calibration / recalibration before deployment
